Australian domestic overnight trips, 1998 Q1 to 2022 Q4

aus_tourism.Rd

Quarterly overnight trips (in thousands) for the 76 tourism regions of Australia, disaggregated by purpose of travel. The data extend tsibble::tourism to 2022 Q4 and map the earlier region names to the revised tourism region boundaries, so that every bottom-level series spans the full 100 quarters. Together with the purpose of travel, the regions form the grouped structure (State / Region) * Purpose, in which regions are nested within states and purpose is crossed with both.

Usage

aus_tourism

Format

A tsibble with 30,400 rows and 5 columns, keyed by State, Region and Purpose and indexed by Quarter.

Quarter

Year-quarter of the trips.

State

State or territory.

Region

Tourism region.

Purpose

Purpose of travel, one of "Business", "Holiday", "Visiting" (visiting friends and relatives) and "Other".

Trips

Overnight trips, in thousands.

Source

Tourism Research Australia, National Visitor Survey. The script that builds the data is in the data-raw directory of the source repository.

Examples

aus_tourism
#> # A tsibble: 30,400 x 5 [1Q]
#> # Key:       State, Region, Purpose [304]
#>    Quarter State Region   Purpose  Trips
#>      <qtr> <chr> <chr>    <chr>    <dbl>
#>  1 1998 Q1 ACT   Canberra Business 150. 
#>  2 1998 Q2 ACT   Canberra Business  99.9
#>  3 1998 Q3 ACT   Canberra Business 130. 
#>  4 1998 Q4 ACT   Canberra Business 102. 
#>  5 1999 Q1 ACT   Canberra Business  95.5
#>  6 1999 Q2 ACT   Canberra Business 229. 
#>  7 1999 Q3 ACT   Canberra Business 109. 
#>  8 1999 Q4 ACT   Canberra Business 159. 
#>  9 2000 Q1 ACT   Canberra Business 105. 
#> 10 2000 Q2 ACT   Canberra Business 202. 
#> # ℹ 30,390 more rows
